name: 45102 · Amelia, OH
findings: ZIP 45102 (Amelia) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45102 (Amelia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45102 (Amelia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
